    p.write_bytes(''.join(lines).encode())
for name, mode in C['changed_modes'].items():
    p = Path(name)
    if p.exists(): p.chmod(int(mode, 8) & 0o777)
manifest = {str(p): sha(p.read_bytes()) for top in ('app', 'library') for p in sorted(Path(top).rglob('*')) if p.is_file()}
docs = {str(p): sha(p.read_bytes()) for p in sorted(Path('docs').rglob('*')) if p.is_file()}
assert len(manifest) == C['production_files'] and sha(jb(manifest)) == C['manifest_sha256'], 'complete app/library manifest'
assert sha(jb(docs)) == C['docs_manifest_sha256'], 'docs manifest'
protected = {n:h for n,h in manifest.items() if n not in C['mutable_source']}
assert sha(jb(protected)) == C['protected_manifest_sha256'], 'all protected production source'
attributes = Path(git('rev-parse', '--git-path', 'info/attributes').decode().strip())
attributes.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
with attributes.open('a') as stream: stream.write('\nlibrary/provision/src/main/assets/terms/** -text !eol\n')
subprocess.run(['git', 'add', '--', 'app', 'library', 'docs'], check=True)
for name, mode in C['changed_modes'].items():
    oid = git('hash-object', '-w', '--stdin', '--no-filters', input=Path(name).read_bytes()).decode().strip()
    subprocess.run(['git', 'update-index', '--cacheinfo', mode, oid, name], check=True)
subprocess.run(['git', '-c', 'core.whitespace=cr-at-eol', 'diff', '--cached', '--check'], check=True)
actual = set(git('diff', '--cached', '--name-only', '-z').decode().split('\0')) - {''}
assert actual == set(changes), (actual, set(changes))
assert set(git('diff', '--cached', '--diff-filter=D', '--name-only').decode().splitlines()) == set(C['deleted']), 'deletion metadata'
env = os.environ.copy()
auth = base64.b64encode((env['GIT_ACTOR'] + ':' + env['GIT_TOKEN']).encode()).decode()
env.update(GIT_CONFIG_COUNT='1', GIT_CONFIG_KEY_0='http.https://github.com/.extraheader', GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_0='AUTHORIZATION: basic ' + auth)
remote = 'https://github.com/kernout/HyperCeiler.git'
ref = 'refs/heads/' + C['branch']
assert not git('ls-remote', remote, ref, env=env).strip(), 'target branch already exists; refusing overwrite'
subprocess.run(['git', 'switch', '-c', C['branch']], check=True)
subprocess.run(['git', '-c', 'user.name=github-actions[bot]', '-c', 'user.email=41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com', 'commit', '-m', 'Queue screen-off camera capture requests'], check=True)
commit = git('rev-parse', 'HEAD').decode().strip()
assert git('rev-parse', 'HEAD^').decode().strip() == C['base']
assert set(git('diff-tree', '--no-commit-id', '--name-only', '-r', '-z', 'HEAD').decode().split('\0')) - {''} == set(changes)
subprocess.run(['git', 'push', remote, 'HEAD:' + ref], env=env, check=True)
assert git('ls-remote', remote, ref, env=env).decode().split()[0] == commit
out = Path('artifacts'); out.mkdir()
info = dict(base=C['base'], production_commit=commit, production_branch=C['branch'], production_files=len(manifest), source_manifest_sha256=C['manifest_sha256'], docs_manifest_sha256=C['docs_manifest_sha256'], delta_sha256=C['delta_sha256'], device_verified=False, build_succeeded=False, signed=False, source_push_verified=True)
(out/'build-info.json').write_bytes(jb(info))
(out/'source-manifest.json').write_bytes(jb(manifest))
(out/'docs-manifest.json').write_bytes(jb(docs))
(out/'protected-source-manifest.json').write_bytes(jb(protected))
assert not Path('signing.properties').exists()
p = Path('settings.gradle.kts')
text, count = re.subn(r'^\s*maven\("https://maven\.aliyun\.com/repository/(?:public|google|gradle-plugin)"\)\s*\n', '', p.read_text(), flags=re.M)
assert count == 3
p.write_text(text)
p = Path('app/build.gradle.kts')
